g.text: A pass: the answer's query returns
the gold result on both databases
Analyzer team: failed dev items only
Overfit guard: rejects a rule that shares 6 words
in a row with any benchmark question, or 20
query tokens in a row with any gold query
Confirming runs, for an item that passed
dev: 2 more runs of each version; a
regression if the candidate fails both
and the active version passes both
holdout: 3 more; a regression if 2 fail
Autonomy per metric family: revenue, orders, average order value, customers, products. A family
reaches the unattended level only when every holdout item of the family passes 2 of 3 runs
under the active version (an item that falls short, 2 of 3 more); other families get the assisted level.
A spent daily budget, 3 escalations in a row, or the kill switch drops the system to the report-only level.
